purpose: State exactly what a Decoder jumpstart target re-executes, what authority its output has, and what historical work is explicitly outside the replay contract.

replay_classes.VERIFY_AUTHORITY: Verify a frozen result/certificate and its source pins; do not claim to rerun the scientific computation that originally produced it.
replay_classes.RERUN_GRADUATION_AUDIT: Re-execute the frozen graduation/classification audit from its declared retained inputs and recompute the scientific graduation result.
replay_classes.REPLAY_BOUNDED_EXPERIMENT: Re-execute one frozen bounded probe, audit, witness or sentinel; conclusions do not automatically generalize beyond that declared experiment/theorem scope.
replay_classes.SCIENTIFIC_RECONSTRUCTION: Reconstruct a scientific result from sealed parent evidence when original result bytes/package are missing; scientific equivalence is the contract, not byte identity.
replay_classes.CHECKPOINT_PREFLIGHT: Verify a checkpoint/capsule and readiness to resume; no scientific result is recomputed by the preflight itself.
replay_classes.FULL_HISTORICAL_CAMPAIGN: The packaged native staged campaign can run/resume through its declared stage sequence; smoke may cover only a preflight stage and does not itself constitute the full campaign.

hard_rules: Replay class is epistemic; launch.resume_semantics is operational. They must not be conflated.
Every active jumpstart profile in a Recovery-v7 runtime must have exactly one replay contract.
Contracts bind exact profile_id, profile_sha256 and target_node_id and fail closed on mismatch.
O2 remains certificate-verification-only until the missing original complete O2 package is recovered or independently rebuilt.
O5 remains a scientific reconstruction and must never claim historical byte identity.
A smoke test never upgrades a CHECKPOINT_PREFLIGHT or FULL_HISTORICAL_CAMPAIGN contract into a completed science replay.
